## Your turn {.smaller}

**Exercise (⭐).** The penalty weight $\lambda = 0.44$ controls smoothness. Refit the
temperature series at $\lambda = 0$ and a large $\lambda = 10$. What do the two
extremes correspond to?

::: {.notes}
**Solution (presenter notes).**

```r
fit0  <- neariso_fit(cdiac$annual, 0)
fit10 <- neariso_fit(cdiac$annual, 10)
c(lambda0_matches_data = max(abs(fit0 - cdiac$annual)) < 1e-4,
  lambda10_is_monotone = all(diff(fit10) >= -1e-4))
```
At $\lambda = 0$ there is no penalty, so the fit just reproduces the data. As
$\lambda \to \infty$ the penalty forces the downward steps to zero --- a fully
**isotonic** (monotone non-decreasing) fit.
:::
